string.name: reason_float_window
string.value: After the user copies text in any app, a draggable bubble appears at the screen edge. Without switching apps, the user can tap the bubble to open a clipboard panel and reuse the most recently copied content. The bubble can dock to the screen edge and be fully disabled in settings

string.name: reason_background
string.value: While the app is in the background, it keeps monitoring system clipboard changes so newly copied content is captured automatically and the floating bubble always shows the latest items without the user reopening the app

string.name: reason_vibrate
string.value: Light vibration feedback when copying succeeds

string.name: reason_read_clipboard
string.value: Read the system clipboard to capture copied content
